title: Engine and Other Machine Assemblers
description: Construct, assemble, or rebuild machines, such as engines, turbines, and similar equipment used in such industries as construction, extraction, textiles, and paper manufacturing.

tasks.text: Read and interpret assembly blueprints or specifications manuals, and plan assembly or building operations.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprints need spatial reading, human verifies sequence

dwas.name: Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.
Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Inspect, operate, and test completed products to verify functioning, machine capabilities, or conformance to customer specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installed assembly inspection needs physical access

tasks.text: Position or align components for assembly, manually or using hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.
Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Verify conformance of parts to stock lists or blueprints, using measuring instruments such as calipers, gauges, or micrometers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Fasten or install piping, fixtures, or wiring and electrical components to form assemblies or subassemblies, using hand tools, rivet guns, or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electromechanical assembly requires hands-on fitting

tasks.text: Remove rough spots and smooth surfaces to fit, trim, or clean parts, using hand tools or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand finishing of metal edges with tools

tasks.text: Lay out and drill, ream, tap, or cut parts for assembly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.
Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.
Lay out parts to prepare for assembly.

tasks.text: Rework, repair, or replace damaged parts or assemblies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly and reassembly of parts

tasks.text: Assemble systems of gears by aligning and meshing gears in gearboxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electromechanical assembly requires hands-on fitting

tasks.text: Set up and operate metalworking machines, such as milling or grinding machines, to shape or fabricate parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Maintain and lubricate parts or components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of lubricants to workpieces

dwas.name: Apply lubricants or coolants to workpieces.
